subject: Wardrobes for sloped ceilings and alcoves
hook: Our walls and ceiling are not straight. Can fitted wardrobes still look right?
fb:
One of the most common worries we hear from people in older houses and loft conversions: our walls are not straight, the ceiling dips, so can fitted wardrobes ever look right?

Yes. In truth, very few walls are perfectly straight, even in newer homes. We build the wardrobe square and level in our Hanley workshop, then on fitting day our own team scribes fillers to follow the exact line of your wall, ceiling or slope.

That is what closes the gaps and makes it look as though it has always been there.

Got a question about your own room? Ask us, or book a free consultation:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=year-end-inspiration-and-trust&utm_content=day-126
gbp:
Can fitted wardrobes look right if the walls and ceiling are not straight?

Yes. Most rooms have walls that lean, ceilings that dip or skirting that runs out of level, especially in older houses and loft conversions. It does not stop a fitted wardrobe looking built in.

We manufacture the wardrobe square and level in our own Hanley workshop. On fitting day, our own installation team scribes fillers on site, shaping each one to follow the exact line of your wall, ceiling or slope. The gaps close, the doors hang true, and the wardrobe looks as though it belongs to the room.

We design wardrobes for sloped ceilings, chimney alcoves and awkward corners across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire. Start with a free, no-obligation design consultation and an itemised quote.
